scheme_name: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister's Fellowship Programme
other_conditions: Must hold a first‑class degree in a professional bachelor's programme (Engineering, Medicine, Law, Agriculture, Veterinary Science) or a first‑class master’s degree in Arts/Science, or an equivalent qualification.
Working knowledge of Tamil is mandatory.
Candidates with a Ph.D. degree will be preferred.
Work experience will be an added advantage.
Strong emphasis will be given to research experience.
Age limits vary by category: general applicants 22‑30 years, SC/ST applicants up to 35 years, BC/MBC applicants up to 33 years.
benefits_summary: Monthly stipend of ₹65,000 plus an additional allowance of ₹10,000 for incidental expenses.
